blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A financial forensic analyst was called into the witness stand by the prosecution on Friday, during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial, overriding objections from the defense team over access to confidential financial statements. Duterte’s defense lead counsel Atty. Sheila Sison questioned the authority of the analyst to get a hold of the documents subpoenaed by the court.
